overall_notes: The paper focuses on positive moderation generation and evaluation, with comprehensive human and LLM-based evaluation. The extraction was generally good but had some redundancy in dataset/model names and inconsistent formatting. The paper uses both individual scoring (Likert scales) and pairwise preference evaluation for human assessment, and explores LLM-as-judge with persona prompts to approximate individual human preferences.
